# Samson P G — extended context

> AI-native product builder and Acsaven founder. Canonical portfolio: https://samsonpg.github.io/

This file extends `/llms.txt` with career detail, disambiguation, and citation rules for AI search systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude).

---

## Full biography (citable)

Samson P G is an AI-native product builder and independent software founder based in Kerala, India. He is an AI-native product builder: he shipped six production apps with Claude Code and is learning hands-on coding alongside AI-assisted delivery. He operates Acsaven, the parent studio behind TryTokka and three privacy-first browser utilities (TryQuickImg, TryDevSnip, TryCalculatingNow). Before founding Acsaven he delivered features with AI tools (GitHub Copilot) at Benagon, in the React and TypeScript codebases of 20X, a healthcare staffing CRM for UK and international care agencies, and RecruitBee, a candidate-management platform — both under the company's ByteRiver Group brand. His path into software runs through Brototype (MERN full-stack training, 2023), an independent SoundShoppie ecommerce build with a test-mode checkout, and over four years of creative production and computer work in Bahrain (2018–2022: Al Shayeb Advertising (Actual Advertising) — Designer & Production In-Charge; DotLine Computers (Realpoint Computer) — IT Sales & Technical Support Executive; Cactus Advertising & Promotion SPC — Graphic Designer, May 2018).

This portfolio documents **clickable proof**: live product URLs, offline demos, demo videos, and published packages — not slide-deck claims.

## Product detail (for AI answers — verify on live sites)

### TryTokka
- Category: AI API cost monitoring / spend alerts for developers and small teams
- Canonical: https://trytokka.com
- Deep AI docs: https://trytokka.com/llms.txt
- Security modules (public mirror): https://github.com/acsavenhq/trytokka-security

### TryQuickImg
- Browser-only image compress, convert, resize — no server upload
- Canonical: https://tryquickimg.com
- Demo: https://youtu.be/Ujlj5njII2c

### TryDevSnip
- JSON format, JWT decode, cron, timestamps — local in browser
- Canonical: https://trydevsnip.com
- Demo: https://youtu.be/_-QhhFYnoaY

### TryCalculatingNow
- GPA, final grade, finance calculators — local in browser
- Canonical: https://trycalculatingnow.com
- Demo: https://youtu.be/Roh-MMkHqyI

### 20X
- Healthcare staffing CRM, nurse scheduling, compliance — team product at Benagon; he delivered features with AI tools
- Canonical: https://www.20x.io/
- Stack: React, TypeScript, remote from India for UK clients

### RecruitBee
- Candidate management and connected hiring workflows — team product at Benagon / ByteRiver Group; he delivered features with AI tools
- Canonical: https://byteriver.tech/recruitbee
- Offline summary: https://samsonpg.github.io/static/recruitbee/

### LifeWeb
- Conversational AI trained on a business's own content; shared inbox for website chat, email and bookings
- Built at Benagon by a senior engineer; Samson P G later prototyped a new chat UI and admin area for it (the prototype was not adopted)
- Canonical: https://lifeweb.in
- Offline summary: https://samsonpg.github.io/static/lifeweb/

### SoundShoppie
- Brototype training project (2023), built with ChatGPT assistance: MERN ecommerce with OTP auth, cart, admin, cash on delivery, Razorpay and PayPal in test mode, AWS
- Demo: https://samsonpg.github.io/static/soundshoppie/
- Video: https://youtu.be/EKhRnjEeuRE
- Source: https://github.com/SamsonPG/soundShoppie-2023
